About 10-fold.** Maddison Project estimates put Japan's 1950 GDP per capita near $3,500 and 2016 near $38,000 (2011 international dollars), roughly an 11-fold rise, so my earlier "20-fold" was wrong. The team note's ~$8,000 for 1950 doesn't match those series, so check its source before relying on it.
